written: 2026-10-19, after the NON-directional discovery search (group A, 2020-2023), before any holdout look
event: the stock touches +5% OR -5% (first touch) from the signal-bar close before the close of the next session
unit: first signal per symbol per day

combos.plain: stock down >15% over 20 days (as of yesterday) AND today's cumulative volume >2x normal for this time of day AND stock down >3% today
stock up >20% over 20 days AND gapped up >5% today AND a 15-min bar closes above the highest high of the previous 20 bars

combos.id: N3 gap-down breakdown in a downtrend
combos.plain: stock below its daily 50-SMA AND gapped down >5% today AND a 15-min bar closes below the lowest low of the previous 20 bars

pass: P(big move) at least 1.5x the base rate of the same set in B_disc, A_hold, B_hold, and above base in LARGE
